user.title: Connect to Deepgram
user.description: Paste a Deepgram API key. Create one at console.deepgram.com.

data_description.api_key: Used for synthesis requests. The voice catalogs are public and need no key.

voice.title: Pick a voice
voice.description: Flux voices are listed first and are all English. Aura voices follow, English first, then the other languages. Each label ends in the model id this entry sends.

data_description.voice: Add a second entry for a second voice. A non-English pipeline picks an Aura voice on its own.

abort.already_configured: This Deepgram voice is already configured.

data_description.speed: Flux voices only. Aura voices ignore this.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach api.deepgram.com to load the voice list.
